note: Legal entity exists and is active: customs records under the Fort, Mumbai registered address run to 2026-02-28, so no liquidation/bankruptcy ground for rejection. Export shipments are factually confirmed with dates, destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers — the company is a genuine exporter of industrial minerals (kaolin, attapulgite, talc, silica quartz grits) from Mundra. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared_hs '382490;841319' does not match any observed shipment. Actual codes seen are 25070029 / 25070010 (kaolin), 25084090 (attapulgite), 25262000 (talc), 25062090 (silica quartz) — i.e. Chapter 25 industrial minerals, not 3824/8413. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual Chapter 25 codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note also that the ImportKey record set mixes genuine exports with unrelated import lines (e.g. Apple Operations / mobile-unit parts HS 85177990, Thiele Kaolin clay imports) — those are inbound or third-party rows and were not counted as export evidence. Revenue and export volume figures: null — no public figure was retrievable within the tool budget (annual report pages blocked, search engine down); not estimated. PAN AAACA0957F was not independently verified (registry sites blocked). Domestic-side evidence is the weak point: no GST band, tender or contract record was obtained, so domestic_status is declared_only, not confirmed.
